final_closeout_requalification.purpose: Run the unchanged decisive suite once more on the exact final governance/evidence branch head after blocker closure, matrix reconciliation, readiness dashboard, release description and closeout persistence.
final_closeout_requalification.expected_result: same scientific decision if governance/evidence descendants preserve the frozen candidate

immutability_rule: During decisive qualification, src, reference, tests/frb01 and the decisive workflow must remain byte-identical to the frozen release candidate. Any production source or reference change invalidates RB1 scientific release qualification and requires a fresh candidate after governed owner qualification/canonical admission. Any decisive test-harness change also requires a fresh release candidate before rerun.
evidence_only_rule: Qualification, dashboard, blocker closure, release description, closeout and this requalification-request descriptor may advance the release branch without changing the scientifically tested src/reference trees. Such evidence-only descendants remain explicitly distinguishable from the frozen release candidate.
historical_evidence_rule: Historical admission gates remain bound to their exact admitted heads. F-RB01 separately establishes current canonical preservation and integrated behavior without replaying historical one-delta assumptions as moving-current requirements.
scope_creep_rule: Capabilities admitted after the frozen RB1 scope remain NEXT_RELEASE by default and do not enlarge the denominator.
